verdict_basis: The deterministic protected-return topology is present and both dense 5x5 neighborhood coverage checks pass, but the frozen D-017 acceptance contract also requires one 8-connected matched-pixel component, exact r3-versus-r2 changed-pixel confinement, preserved nonprotected raster behavior, and an original-resolution overlay that does not read as physical structure. Those required checks fail.

authority.qa_scope: Independent read-only source, pixel, visual, and runtime-isolation review followed by writing only this QA report.

artifact_receipts.integrity_limitation: This lane independently matched all frozen byte and SHA-256 receipts and successfully decoded both PNGs. It did not independently recalculate every PNG chunk CRC; the exact r3 PNG hash matches the generation report that records those CRCs.

deterministic_topology_coverage.sampling_rule: For each segment, sample s=0 through floor(length) at one-pixel arclength, then sample the exact endpoint when length is nonintegral. Round each projected sample center to the nearest integer pixel and search its inclusive 5x5 neighborhood.
deterministic_topology_coverage.adjudication: The source contains the intended topology and every required neighborhood contains a threshold-matching pixel. This narrow deterministic-coverage pass does not satisfy the separate connectivity, confinement, raster-preservation, style, or fallback gates.

matched_pixel_connectivity.collection_rule: Union every boundary-color-mask pixel found inside every required protected-segment 5x5 station neighborhood, then compute 8-connected components within that matched set.
matched_pixel_connectivity.failure: The D-017 contract requires all matched protected pixels plus endpoints and elbow to belong to one 8-connected component; the observed matched set has 19 components.
matched_pixel_connectivity.interpretation_limitation: Because the collection rule includes all threshold-matching pixels in each 5x5 neighborhood, nearby same-color structural strokes can enter the set. That limitation is preserved rather than hidden. The independent changed-pixel-confinement failure below is decisive even if a narrower connectivity interpretation were later adopted.

decompressed_r3_vs_r2_diff.comparison: Decoded 24-bit RGB pixels, using pixel centers x+0.5 and y+0.5 for exact point-to-segment Chebyshev distance.
decompressed_r3_vs_r2_diff.required_confinement: Every changed pixel must be within a Chebyshev 3-pixel band of T2->T3->T4.
decompressed_r3_vs_r2_diff.nonprotected_interior_rule: T1->T2 and T4->T5 exclude the square of Chebyshev radius 3 at their shared protected endpoint; T0->T1 and T5->T0 have no protected shared endpoint.
decompressed_r3_vs_r2_diff.failure: Ten decoded pixels change far outside the only authorized protected-return band, including four along T0->T1 and six along T5->T0. The exact frozen confinement and nonprotected-preservation contract therefore fails even though the visible color deltas are small.

At original resolution it reads as a structural seam or rail and weakens the normal occlusion and depth cues of those unrelated visible forms.
original_resolution_visual_gate.contract_implication: D-017 explicitly requires rejection when the overlay reads as physical structure or flattens unrelated geometry beyond a clearly technical topology role. The guide does not visually distinguish that role.
